blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Dengue has swept through all 27 villages of this town, a commercial hub of Agusan del Sur province, infecting 432 residents and claiming two lives as of Wednesday, according to the Municipal Health Office (MHO). The surge mirrors a wider health crisis across Agusan del Sur, which was placed under a province-wide outbreak on Oct. 1 as infections topped 2,700 and the death toll rose to at least 18. San Francisco remains among the hardest-hit localities, trailing only Rosario, Loreto, and Bunawan.
